subject: health
unitTitle: Sexual Health, Safety, and Community Wellbeing
title: Guided practice: infection prevention concepts
essentialQuestion: How can understanding sexual health, safety, and community wellbeing help us explain, decide, create, or solve something that matters?
materials: unit-specific source, model, manipulatives, safe materials, or approved digital tool
keyPoints: Infection prevention depends on how a particular infection spreads; accurate information, hygiene, vaccination when applicable, and healthcare guidance interrupt different routes.
Identify the actual biological process or transmission route, choose prevention or care that interrupts it, and correct myths without blaming or stigmatizing a person.
For infection prevention concepts, a strong response distinguishes fact from assumption, uses a fictional or public case, and includes a safe next step or appropriate source of support.
privacySafeScenario: Complete an age-appropriate, fact-based safety and advocacy project with a private question channel and family review option.
studentTask: Create a cause-and-interruption map for a supplied fictional case about infection prevention concepts: name the relevant process or transmission route, add two accurate prevention or care supports, and correct one misconception using the lesson facts.
knowledgeCheck: In two or three sentences, explain the most important distinction in infection prevention concepts; use one lesson fact and name the evidence, safety check, or support route that makes the explanation dependable.
completionCriteria: The response completes every named part of the infection prevention concepts task using the supplied fictional or public case.
The response uses at least two accurate details from the lesson instruction and distinguishes evidence from assumption.
The response gives a safe, feasible next step or support route and does not depend on private disclosure, body comparison, or recorded media proof.
